pages.title: You Keep Going
pages.text: There is $(o)no death screen$(). You die, and a moment later you are awake at your bed.$(br2)Your things do not come with you. They stay in a $(l)corpse$() where you fell, holding everything you had.

pages.title: The Cost Is The Walk
pages.text: Dying never costs you your gear and never costs you your base. It costs you $(o)the trip back$().$(br2)That is the whole point. Dying nine hundred blocks down is a real loss of an evening, and dying in your wheat field is nothing at all. The danger scales with how far you went.
